```{r}
library(cowsay)
species <- c("frog", "stegosaurus", "squirrel", "spider")

for (spp in species) {
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, 's')
  say(paste('Do I start with an s?', has_s), spp)
}
```

```{r}
species <- c("monkey", "shark", "turkey", "snowman")
species_df <- tibble()

for (spp in species){
  has_s <- startsWith(spp, 's')
  current_row <- tibble(Species = spp, Starts_with_S = has_s)
  species_df <- species_df |> bind_rows(current_row)
}
gt(species_df)
```

```{r}
menu <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
breakfast = tibble()

for (i in seq_len(10)){
  dish <- sample(menu, size = 1)
  num <- sample(seq_len(5), size = 1)
  current_dish <- tibble(Dish = dish, Number = num)
  breakfast <- breakfast |>
    bind_rows(current_dish)
}

gt(breakfast)
```
